title: LIAR GAME

opinions.point: Viewers generally praised the episode’s strategic twists and psychological game-playing.
Many felt Nao’s development and increasing competence were especially satisfying.
The character interactions and romantic humor were frequently described as entertaining.
Several commenters enjoyed the voice acting and distinctive whispered delivery.
Some viewers found the series’ earlier pacing uneven and certain games difficult to follow, though they still enjoyed the finale.
A few comments criticized the limited animation quality and modest production budget.

notes: The title clearly matches LIAR GAME episode 26. Search results exposed the thread and comment text, including approximately 20 substantive comments, but did not reliably expose the official comment count; score was shown as 100. Reactions are paraphrased and plot details are omitted.
